rows.en: ...Hey! All that damage we took is gone like it never happened!!
...Hm? ...Come to think of it, my body suddenly feels lighter, too.
Ah... Me too! My wounds healed before I even noticed!!
I don't know why, but since coming here, everyone's strength recovered in no time.
Yeah. This place is clearly different from where we just were.
That said, it doesn't seem to be our own world either...
But there's no sign of any enemies here at all!!
Now that you mention it, you're right!!
All right, let's split up and investigate this place.
The three of them decided to look around this place...
Ultraman Zero and the others had reached a place made up of several rooms and facilities.
Lucky for us there's a medical room here. We can get treated there.
Thanks to it, I was able to heal my wounds.
That's a "medical capsule."
It's technology from my world... Seems this place has the same technology.
Is that so? With that machine, we can heal our wounds safely.
Oh, everyone.
By the way, the room over there had lots of items that look useful in battle.
That's a big help.
...I don't know why, but as long as we're here, our lives don't seem to be in danger.
Hey! There's another hole open over there.
Really!?
Yeah. If we use it, we should be able to get somewhere else.
Somewhere else...? Where does it lead?
I don't know. Not until we go and see.
Everyone... We have a mountain of things to look into.
What this world is... and what we have to do to get back to our own worlds...
For now, let's make this place our "base," then go past the hole Zero found and explore every inch.
Yeah, you're right.
I agree.
All right, then let's get ready to head out.
Would you like to view the tutorial on Random Cubes?

Would you like to view the tutorial on Equipment Upgrades?
You can view tutorials at any time from the Camp Menu.
Would you like to view the tutorial on Idle Actions?
You can view tutorials at any time from the Camp Menu.
You can view this same tutorial at any time from the Camp Menu.
"Parallel universes"... Ours is not the only universe in existence.
Many universes exist, and each one has its own, very similar "Earth."
Those worlds were never meant to cross paths. Not until that "Anomaly" occurred...
The "Anomaly" began suddenly, at nearly the same moment on every universe's Earth.
Cracks ran across the sky, and a vortex of darkness assailed the Earth.
Everything was swept up and sucked into the cracks.
Civilizations, living things, even minds and memories... Every last thing...
It all fused together in a "hyperspace" outside every universe, giving birth to a new "world" there.
A world filled with malice and ruled by fear...
But amid that chaos, there were those who shone like brilliant stars.
Yes, the heroes!
Gathered as if guided by fate, they have now begun to act! To save the Earth!
...Looks like someone's arrived.
That makes three now...
...This one's a different type from us.
Are you all right!? Hang in there!!
...Did the shock of getting pulled in knock them out?
...Ugh.
Looks like they've just passed out.
Hey! Can you hear us?
All right, they'll be fine now!
Looks like you're awake.
...What?
What... is this place...!?
Wh-what are you guys!?
Calm down. It looks like you're a "hero" just like us.
We're heroes too, same as you.
Heroes...? I don't know any of you!
That goes both ways.
Seems each of us got pulled in here from a different world, too.
Same goes for you, right?
...Pulled in?
Ah... yeah, that's right... I remember now...
I was training on Planet K76...
Suddenly, a pitch-black hole opened in the sky, and a violent storm kicked up.
I took off to find out what was causing it, but the wind kept getting stronger...
...and it looks like I got sucked right in...
I see... Just like what happened to us.

notes.note: Event/Base/Command/0985.bla checked: MessWinSet TextIdOffset+N plays entry N+1 (+0 -> 0.1 OOO, +22 -> 0.23 Nu Gundam, +23 -> 0.24 narration; entry 0.25 is empty, +25 -> 0.26 narration). Chara 5 = OOO, 6 = Nu Gundam, 15 = Zero. All slice labels match the script.

Rows 0.15-0.22 are never played (script jumps from +13 to +22). They copy MainEventMess0991 #0.28-0.35 (story_179); that English is reused. Inferred speakers as in story_179: 0.15 Zero, 0.16 Nu Gundam, 0.17 OOO, 0.18 Nu Gundam, 0.19 Zero, 0.20 Nu Gundam, 0.21 OOO, 0.22 Zero.
Differs from the 0991 copy only by an added 'come to think of it'; added to the reused line.
Rows 0.29-0.32 are never played (script jumps +27 -> +32). Inferred: 0.29-0.30 Nu Gundam (tech from his world), 0.31-0.32 OOO (polite; 0.32 'Oh, everyone' leads into OOO's 0.33).
'medical capsule' kept in the source's quotes; the glossary's 'regeneration capsule' is a different source word. Not in glossary.
'our own worlds' (plural) since the three come from different worlds; source has no possessor.
'base' keeps the source's quotation marks as in story_002 #0.97.

Tutorial prompts follow story_019 wording ('Would you like to view the tutorial on X?'); Random Cube, Equipment Upgrade and Idle Action follow glossary/system UI. The 0996 (Hangar) and 0997 (Shop) scripts call Tutorial_08/06 directly and use no MessWinSet.

Command/0998 and Top/0998 scripts only play +0 (YesNo -> 0.1) and +2 (OkWin -> 0.3). Rows 0.5-0.51 (and 0.2) are an unused early draft of the opening (story_001 MainEventMess01); no speakers in the script.

'hyperspace' for the source's quoted 'super-space' term; not in glossary (story_001's version said 'dimensional space' for a different word).

Source says the newcomer is the 'third person' (story_001's version said fourth); kept 'three' even though W appears later in this draft.
Unconscious newcomer's identity unknown to the speakers; 'them' as in story_001.
Continues 0.49's trailing clause; lowercase start marks the continuation.
